description: Read the comments of one issue of a project's own Jira (see get_linked_jira_issue), the newest first: who wrote each, when and what, and how many there are in all. Name the project by 'project', or an issue here by 'issue' — then its project's Jira is read, and the issue's own key there is the default. For the people who work in the project; at most 10 reads of the linked Jira a minute per person.

issue.description: An issue here, e.g. 'PM-12': its project's Jira is read, and its own key there unless 'jiraKey' says otherwise.

jiraKey.description: The issue there: 'ACME-123' or its /browse/ link. Optional when 'issue' has a key there.

limit.description: How many of the latest, at most 30. Default 10.

project.description: Project key here, e.g. 'PM'. Or give 'issue'.

name: get_linked_jira_comments
